info.name: Oracle Database MultiCloud Data Plane Integration Oracle DB Azure Blob Mount API
Lists all Oracle DB Azure Blob Mount resources based on the specified filters.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return Oracle DB Azure Blob Mount resources that match the specified display name.

params.name: oracleDbAzureBlobMountId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the Oracle DB Azure Blob Mount resource.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given lifecycle state. The state value is case-insensitive.

params.name: oracleDbAzureBlobContainerId
params.description: A filter to return Oracle DB Azure Blob Container resource.

params.name: oracleDbAzureConnectorId
params.description: A filter to return Oracle DB Azure Azure Identity Connector resources.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending. If no value is specified, default is timeCreated.

items.docs: Lists all Oracle DB Azure Blob Mount resources based on the specified filters.
